Pre-Qualification Criteria:The intending bidder can submit bids as an Individual bidder along with Tie-up of pump manufacturer. The Tie-up is to be formed prior to the bidding. Tenders from a Tie-up proposed in this bid, the bidder shall upload an agreement with only one pump manufacturer on Rs 200-00 stamp paper in the prescribed format which shall be concluded prior to bidding and enclosed to the bid document. For proof of the Tie up, in the Technical bid, the prescribed format under section 2 - instruction to tenderer (ITT) shall be followed.

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of contract value) at least one similar nature of work such as Construction of Bridge cum Barrage (Minimum Barrage length of 140m ) and Construction of Lift Irrigation scheme costing not less than Rs.1268.82 Lakhs (i.e., not less than 50% of the amount put to tender) on turnkey basis in the last five years (i.e., from 2020-21 to 2024-25). The work done certificate shall be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division / equivalent officer and countersigned by the Superintending Engineer of the concerned circle / next higher officer. The cost shall be updated to the present value by giving weightage at 10% each year, if the work is completed prior to the year 2025-26.

The intending bidder should have executed a minimum quantity of following specific items of work in anyone financial year, during the last five financial years reckoned back from 2024-25. Certificate should be obtained from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division and countersigned by the SE of the concerned Circle. i.e, Earthwork Excavation/ Embankment or both put together 20355 Cum, Reinforced Cement Concrete (M-15 Grade and above) 6072 Cum, Reinforcement steel 327 MT, Structural steel 18 MT.

Turnover: The intending bidder in his/its name should have In the last 5 years i.e., 2020-21to 2024-25 achieved in at least 2 financial years, a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 3383.52 Lakhs (usually not less than two times the estimated annual payments under this contract. The turnover prior to FY 2024-25 will be updated to the Present Price Level by giving weight age of 10% each year. Audited Profit and Loss account certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant bearing UDIN along with copy of Income Tax returns filed for the years indicated above should be furnished. FY2025-26.

The Intending Bidder should furnish liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 761.29 Lakhs from any Nationalized / scheduled bank Credit lines/letter of credit/certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. A format attached in the page Number 33 for Work-1, 31 for Work-2 of Bid Document.

Pump: 2 numbers of VT pumps with a capacity (flow rate) not less than 0.15 cumecs for each pump with a head not less than 50 m for each pump during the last 5 years (i.e., from 2020-21 to 2024-25). The necessary work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of EE and countersigned by the SE of the same circle should be uploaded.

Rising Main: The intending bidder should have laid and tested minimum quantity of MS rising pressure pipe system of the work with following diameter of pipes in any one financial year, during the last 5 financial years (i.e., from 2020-21 to 2024-25) Certificate should be obtained from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of concerned division and counter signed by the S.E. of the concerned Circle or equivalent in case of other Government Undertaking within India. M.S. pipe with inner diameter not less than 500 mm for length 3.39 Km for M.S. pressure distribution system

(a).Availability by owning at least 50% of the required / specified key and critical equipment for this work.(b).Each tenderer should demonstrate availability of few key equipments/machinery for execution of the work.(c).However, it is obligatory for the contractor to use the following machineries for various activities of roadwork /Irrigation works involved in construction as per MORTH specification and Irrigation manual Concrete mixer-3 Nos 2 Own/1 Hire/Lease, Tipper-6 Nos 3 Own/3 Hire/Lease, Transit Mixer-2 Nos 1 Own/1 Hire/Lease, Vibrating road roller-1 Nos 1 Own, Excavator 3 Nos 2 Own/1 Hire/Lease, Water tanker-2 Nos 2 Hire/Lease, CRANE- Capacity 20 Tonnes above-1 Nos 1Own.

BID CAPACITY:The tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value the available tender Capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed available tender Capacity is equal to (AxNx1.5-B) Where A is Maximum value of civil engineering works Executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2025-26 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N is Number of years i.e., (18 months) prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B is Value, at 2025-26 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next (Period of completion of the works for which tenders are invited). If a bidder participates in more than one bid and technically qualifies and subsequently becomes lowest in more number of bids than his/her bid capacity, then the tenderer can give his option to select the works based on his/her preference equivalent to his bid capacity. Further for the balance bids next lowest bidders will be eligible to accept at lowest bidders rates equivalent to their bid capacity provided if the competent authority accepts it.

Note:-1:The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be certified by statutory auditors of the company or by the proprietor of the company through an affidavit.

Note:-2: Even though the bidders meet the above criteria they are subject to be disqualified if they have (a). Made misleading or false representations in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and /or, (b)Record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion, litigation history and financial failures etc., and /or, (c). Participated in the previous tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high tender prices and could not furnish rational justification. If the bidder/bidders have participated more than one work, the available tender capacity will be assessed and number of works will be awarded as per his available bid capacity.

With respect to stipulation of Assessed available tender capacity, the bidder has to fill the information on the format given in the Qualification information CONTRACT DATA REQUIREMENT and upload the details in the prescribed format. The information submitted shall be used for the purpose of competing tender capacity at the time of Technical bid evaluation.

Cover-II shall contain a financial Bid:The Cover-I (Technical bid) will be opened first and thereafter Cover-II (financial bid) will be opened only for those bidders who qualifies in the technical bid. In case the lowest bidder fails to produce the original documents for entering into an agreement or the original documents submitted does not match with the uploaded documents or found false, then his bid is treated as non-responsive bid as per clause-26(4) of the KTPP rules & his name would be removed from the select list of KNNL enrolment and barred from participation in any of the tenders invited by the KNNL apart from forfeiting the EMD paid through e-cash.
